summary:
Turn 71 brought the map up to date with the strengthened recovery finding.

State on entry. The full-history scenario for C1 was reviewed last turn: the committed record is now produced by the implementation — the owner admits a client proposal, runs a real PreAccept round, fast-commits and broadcasts the Commit to another replica — and only then does a replica that never saw the instance recover it and skip that committed reply, with the same adoption, propagation and applied-state consequences. That removed the prepared-record limitation the earlier reviews carried, so the map's wording needed to stop implying that basis.

Map update (accepted base version 14, two clarified objects). Behavior B11-prepare-resolution's selection branch now records that the strongest scenario drives a real proposal and commit before the recovery, naming the artifact; core_overview's context clause says the same, so the overview no longer reads as if an installed committed record were the basis. Both objects carry map_changes entries with sources and preserves explanations, and nothing else in the map moved — formation, connection, the other branches and the open details are untouched.

Frontier at this point. Ten claim families are settled: eight confirmed violations or consequences (C1 recovery divergence with its five artifacts including the driven-history one, C2 durable-record layout, C3 applied-state divergence, C4 NOOP-commit crash, C6 promoted-leader variant, C7 dead accept-rejection path, C9 recorder row in two scenarios, C10 codec in three scenarios up to a receiver decode panic) and two bounded no-violation protections (C5 owner-alive re-proposal, C8 executor timeout enqueue). Two candidates remain paused with scoped resume conditions, one issue remains structurally unresolvable on a superseded artifact, and the unread items are named: the reader-side reaction to a displaced stream, whether the client caps the command size it builds, and whether any caller enables durable recording. No requirement, premise or earlier observation was weakened.
